title: Flood dated up to 40,000 years ago from ice cores
summary: Matt tells of Flood dated up to 40,000 years ago from ice cores, about up to 40,000 years ago at Mesopotamia / Greenland and Antarctic ice cores, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Mesopotamia / Greenland and Antarctic ice cores

tellings.quote: could be up to 40,000 years ago based on looking at ice course sampling and previous climatic events of when floods could have occurred

plain: A researcher identified only as Matt, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, talks about the great flood told of in ancient stories from Mesopotamia, the land of modern Iraq. Matt says the flood could have happened up to 40,000 years ago, based on ice cores, long columns of ice drilled from Greenland and Antarctica that record past climate, and on earlier climate events when floods could have occurred. If true, the old flood stories would reach back much further than usually thought.
